SELECT d.fiscal_period, MIN(d.calendar_date) mn, MAX(d.calendar_date) mx, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dl, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS drl, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'sales' src, p.category, p.subcategory,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS outside_validity, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND p.subcategory IN ('Outdoor Lighting')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', p.category, p.subcategory,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.return_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), COUNT(*), SUM(f.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND p.subcategory IN ('Outdoor Lighting')
GROUP BY 1,2,3

SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp,
 MIN(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) mn, MAX(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) mx
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-10-20' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-05-10' GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.sales_line_id AS id, 'S' AS k
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net, r.return_line_id, 'R'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k='S' THEN n.net_sales END) AS sold, SUM(CASE WHEN k='R' THEN n.net_sales END) AS ret,
  COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (k,id)) dn
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category='Garden' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-05-10' AND (p.product_key IS NULL OR s.store_key IS NULL)) AS orphan_sales,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND (p.product_key IS NULL OR s.store_key IS NULL)) AS orphan_ret,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27') AS dup_ret_id,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS multi_ret_per_line,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-20' AND DATE '2025-05-10' AND (o.web_order_id IS NULL OR o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL)) AS web_lines_no_dispatch,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND f.channel_code='WB') AS store_lines_wb

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900
),
w AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(v) wh FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
      WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(net_sales) rp FROM rpt_daily_store_sales t JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=t.business_date
      WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND t.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT w.fiscal_period, wh, rp, wh-rp diff FROM w JOIN r USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
